subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> 是 <Picture 1>（慧娘原图）中的刘慧娘，外貌、服饰、发型、神态完全沿用原图，目标视频中不做任何改动。
<Subject 2> 是玉郎，容貌、发型、身形源自 <Picture 2>（玉郎原图），服饰改为文本指定的红色新娘服（红色绣花对襟袍裙、金线滚边）；六镜保持一致。
<Subject 3> 是夜晚烛光下的中式传统内室环境，场景、陈设、灯光布局源自 <Picture 3>（环境原图），暖色低饱和。

summary:
[reference generation] 目标视频呈现 <Subject 2>（容貌源自 <Picture 2>、穿红色新娘服的玉郎）向 <Subject 1>（完全参考 <Picture 1> 的慧娘）告白的六镜烛光戏，场景完全沿用 <Subject 3>（<Picture 3>）；<Subject 1> 外貌服饰完全沿用 <Picture 1>。

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - 慧娘的外貌、服饰、发型、神态全部沿用 <Picture 1> 原图，不做改动。
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3], [Shot 5]): partially_preserved - 容貌、发型、身形沿用 <Picture 2>，服饰改为红色新娘服（文本指定），与源图着装不同。
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]–[Shot 6]): fully_preserved - 中式内室的场景、陈设、烛光布局全部沿用 <Picture 3> 原图。

detailed_description:
目标视频为实拍电影感，场景完全沿用 <Subject 3>（<Picture 3>）的夜晚烛光中式传统内室，暖色低饱和灯光。
[Shot 1] 近景固定，<Subject 2> 玉郎(S1) 容貌源自 <Picture 2>、身着红色新娘服（红色绣花对襟袍裙、金线滚边）出现在烛光中，受宠若惊又得意，眼睛微睁、露出得意浅笑，用清亮带调侃的少年男声说：<d>[Chinese] 真的?你也别嫁裴政呗。</d>
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1> 慧娘(S2), who fully references <Picture 1> in appearance and clothing; she gives Yu Lang a sidelong glance and rolls her eyes, then says in a helpless, slightly exasperated young female voice: <d>[Chinese] 说得轻巧,婚事是父母定的,我能怎么办?</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 2> 玉郎(S1) (appearance from <Picture 2>, in the red bridal dress); he blurts the words out as if against his will, lips parting in a flicker of surprise at himself, and says: <d>[Chinese] 那……那你嫁我呗。</d> Both (<Subject 2> and <Subject 1>) freeze, expressions going blank, motion halting.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1> 慧娘(S2) (referencing <Picture 1>); her face flushes red all at once in the candlelight as the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, and she says in a hesitant, shy young female voice: <d>[Chinese] 你……你认真的?</d>
[Shot 5] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 2> 玉郎(S1) (appearance from <Picture 2>, still in the red bridal dress); he steels himself, straightening and nodding with forced resolve, and says in a nervous but determined young male voice: <d>[Chinese] 认真的!……你要是不嫌弃我,我明天就跟我娘说,把咱俩的事定了!</d>

overall_soundscape: 寂静夜里蜡烛轻爆，衣料窸窣伴随每个动作；玉郎红新娘服的衣料摩擦声更明显。慧娘拳头轻捶玉郎衣袖一声闷响，随后相视而笑的轻喘。
non_diegetic_music: 缓慢稀疏的拨弦五声音阶（似古筝）首句随台词进入，告白出口时轻柔上扬，两人相视一笑时收为一记长音缓缓淡出。
